contentText: Last week an Immigration and Customs Enforcement Agent shot and killed Renee Good, a Minneapolis mother who was observing a law enforcement action carried out by the agency. On January 12, the State of Minnesota and its capital twin cities have filed a lawsuit against the Department of Homeland Security to prevent surge deployment of more ICE officers to the democrat-led State, which been a target of US President Donald Trump's crackdown on Immigration.
